title: Retire event
description: An agent takes cards off the board for good: one card `n`, or a whole container `region` with every card in it now; from v16 the person too (`retire_cards`), one or more cards or a container. Retired cards keep their versions, notes and number; they leave the board, its counts and every list, and their numbers are never given again. A card still owed an answer (a comment or More context with no reply, or a Later with no handover) can't be retired by an agent until it has answered it; the person may remove it.

region.description: In place of `n`: the container to retire, with every card in it now. Its id is never used again on this board.

sentRules.description: One card (`n`) or one container (`region`), never both.
sentRules.$comment: Kept apart from `core` so a failed rule never hides which fields are known (see common.schema.json `stampAgent`). Was: api.md 126

by.description: Who wrote the line: `agent`, or from v16 `person` (retire_cards).

board.description: The board the line belongs to; the server takes it from the path.

cards.description: Every card the line took off the board, by ledger number: the one named, or every card in the container at this line (the person's moves count). The server fills it in.

rules.description: Without a container, a retire takes at least one card; a person's line is from v16 (retire_cards).
rules.$comment: Kept apart from `core` so a failed rule never hides which fields are known (see common.schema.json `stampAgent`). Was: api.md 126, 141
